info.title: JumpShip API
info.description: AI-powered job search. Resume parsing, multi-source scraping, LLM job assessment, tailored resume generation.

post.description:
Upload a résumé (PDF or DOCX), extract text, and use the LLM
to return a structured ResumeProfile. Nothing is persisted.
LLM override fields can be sent as additional form fields.

Generate a tailored resume PDF for a specific job.

- LLM produces HTML (ATS-oriented template) tailored to the job + assessment gaps
- HTML is converted to a styled single-page PDF via xhtml2pdf
- Returns the PDF as a file download
- Stores metadata in `generated_resumes` table

Generate a tailored resume for a tracked application.
Accepts resume text directly (from cache or user edit), plus optional customizations.

get.description: Return all previously generated resumes (metadata only, no file content).

schema.title: Response List Generated Resumes Api Resume Generated Get

get.description: Re-download a previously generated resume PDF.

Return available models for Ollama or LM Studio.

Ollama: merges /api/tags (installed) + /api/ps (currently running, catches
cloud models like gemma4:31b-cloud that are active but not locally stored).
LM Studio: /v1/models as-is.

schema.title: Response Ollama Models Api Ollama Models Get

get.description: Proxy Groq's /v1/models endpoint and return available model IDs.

schema.title: Response Groq Models Api Groq Models Get

post.description:
Test the user-supplied LLM configuration and return a clear pass/fail message.
For Ollama: tries the given URL and common fallback addresses so we can
report which one actually works (helps Linux/Ubuntu users debug IP issues).

Search for jobs using python-jobspy + extra sources and return structured results.

Per-source outcome is returned in the X-Source-Status header:
JSON {site: {"count": int, "error": str | null}} (ASCII-escaped).

schema.title: Response Search Jobs Endpoint Api Jobs Search Post

post.description: Assess candidate fit for a single job. Local LLM calls are serialized via semaphore.

Assess multiple jobs concurrently.
Cloud providers: all run in parallel.
Local providers: serialized via semaphore (no GPU contention).

schema.title: Response Assess Batch Endpoint Api Jobs Assess Batch Post

post.description: Use the LLM to suggest related keywords/synonyms for better search coverage.
Translate keywords to another language for broader job board coverage.

post.description: Create or fully replace the user profile.

get.description: Probe local LLM providers and return all discovered models.

post.description:
Build (or resume) an interview session.
If application_id matches an existing InterviewSession, returns its persisted state.
Otherwise builds a fresh context (web research + persona + track detection) and persists.
Frontend stores session_context and passes it back in every /chat call.
Run one turn of a mock interview. Autosaves to DB if session_id is provided.

get.description: Returns persisted InterviewSession for an Application, or 404 if none.

post.description: Generate (or return cached) end-of-interview performance report.

delete.description: Remove a saved job from the database.

post.description:
Upload a resume (PDF or DOCX).
Parses the text and stores it in the database.
Only one resume is kept at a time — uploading a new one replaces the previous.
